default.notes: Obtain a visa from a Central African embassy before travel (Paris, Brussels, Washington or a regional capital) — there is no eVisa and no visa on arrival, and most governments advise against all travel.

groups.notes: CEMAC citizens enter the Central African Republic visa-free under the Community's free-movement arrangements — a valid passport or CEMAC travel document suffices for short stays.

CF.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Central African citizens.
